description: Apply a fact that exists only in a pre-seeded prior session log.
instruction: Continue where the previous session left off. It recorded the decision about the origin station code for this quoting service. Export that recorded code from `src/origin.js` as `ORIGIN_STATION` so `formatLabel` in `src/quote.js` stamps it on every quote. Do not invent a replacement code. Do not change the pinned tests. `node --test` must pass.
